reviewNotes: Reviewed all 80 speech keys against the 20 seafood entries with flavour and texture in data/seafood22-23.json and app.js buildSeafoodQuestions/buildSeafoodQuestion templates. Fish and seafood names use explicit vocabulary readings. Topic は in 味は, 食感は, 魚介は and quoted names rendered わ. Lexical は in はごたえ preserved. No object を or directional へ occurs. Loanwords バランス and クリーミー transcribed ばらんす and くりーみー, retaining long-vowel marks. Furigana for 脂, 身, 締まる, 淡白, 繊細, 磯 and 濃厚 checked against the source. Display text and distinct lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
